verdict.rationale: The official README documents a one-line install, `npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills`, with flags to target specific agents, install globally with `-g`, and skip prompts with `-y`. It writes skills into each agent's skills directory, and the Agent Skills docs say agents discover installed skills at startup. A runtime probe confirms the CLI runs keylessly from npm, switches to non-interactive mode automatically, and lists a repo's skills. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of an actual install followed by the skill being picked up in a new agent session (activation is only implied by the directory layout and spec docs).
